_comment: shrinkcode.config.example.json — copy to shrinkcode.config.json at your project root. Every field is optional; scripts work identically with no config file present. Strict JSON: use _comment sibling keys for inline notes on OBJECTS only (no // comments; never put _comment strings inside arrays, they would be read as values). Precedence: explicit CLI flag > this file > built-in defaults.
_comment.excludePaths: glob patterns every bundled script skips (generated code, vendored deps, migrations). Examples below.
_comment.commands: how to run tests/coverage for this project, so Phase 2/5 verification and coverage_gap_scaffold.py don't have to guess or ask every time.
coverageCommand: coverage run -m pytest && coverage json -o coverage.json

duplication._comment: defaults for find_duplicates.py / js_analyze.mjs; --min-lines / --similarity CLI flags still override these

complexity._comment: functions scoring above warnThreshold are flagged in reports (same '1 + decision points' scale for Python and JS/TS)

_comment.riskOverrides: force listed paths to at-least the given tier (1/2/3) regardless of what static analysis suggests — safety valve for teams who know their own risk areas (e.g. payments never auto-classified Tier 1).
_comment.targetReductionPercent: optional; used by references/compression-plan-template.md to state upfront whether the target looks achievable

ci._comment: consumed by scripts/ci_diff_report.py + .github/workflows/shrinkcode.yml; default is comment-only, never failing the check — bloat going up shouldn't block a merge unless the team opts in
